description: Coordinator bootstrap reconstructs only %{logs: ...} for Director recovery, but stores it in the live transaction_system_layout slot. Late-Link replay then publishes that partial map as runnable cluster state; Repo starts a TransactionBuilder and ReadVersions crashes on missing :epoch. Separate recovery-source layout from the currently runnable TSL. Runtime fetch/replay must return unavailable while recovery is active, Director must retain the old/log-only input, and publishing a completed TSL must atomically refresh both the live layout and the next recovery source. Cover bootstrap/mid-recovery late registration and live-layout publication via TDD.

comments.text: TDD complete: added red coverage for bootstrap initialization, recovery-only late registration, unavailable runtime fetch, clearing live state while preserving recovery input, and atomic publication. Implemented separate old_transaction_system_layout and transaction_system_layout lifecycles. Full suite: 13 doctests, 158 properties, 2549 tests passing; mix quality passing.

title: Do not publish bootstrap recovery hints as runnable TSLs
